reviews.reviewText: My daughter feels safe and at home here. The biometric entry and CCTV gave us complete peace of mind, and the food is fresh and homely. As parents, this is exactly what we were looking for near Gurukripa Coaching.
Coaching is literally in front of the gate, so I save almost two hours of travel every day. Four meals daily, a quiet study hall, and steady WiFi — everything a serious NEET aspirant needs.
Good hostel with a disciplined environment. Rooms are clean and the AC works well through the Rajasthan summer. Wardens are strict but genuinely helpful during exam season.

We visited several hostels before choosing Sunrise. The fully-AC campus, the mess quality, and the safety arrangements were clearly the best in the area. Staff keep us updated about our son regularly.
The girls wing is spotless and very secure. Lady wardens on every floor and home-style meals make it feel like a second home. Two years here and I would not change a thing.
Best decision for my JEE prep year. The library and study hall stay open late, and the every-day-special dinner keeps morale up. Highly recommend to anyone studying at Gurukripa.
Clean rooms, polite staff and good hygiene in the mess. WiFi could be a touch faster in the evenings, but overall a very comfortable and safe stay for my daughter.
Fully AC campus, RO water, hot water on every floor, and a warden who actually picks up the phone. My parents stopped worrying after their first visit. That says everything.
Homely food, spotless washrooms and a genuinely caring team. The open space and playground help take a break from studies. Feels safe and well-managed at all hours.
